results.title: Single-Family-Owned 2002 Jaguar XKR 100 Convertible at No Reserve
results.description: This 2002 Jaguar XKR convertible is one of 500 XKR 100 examples produced to commemorate the 100th anniversary of the birth of Jaguar co-founder Sir William Lyons. It was reportedly used as a dealer display model before being purchased by the seller's father, and it has 12k miles. The car is finished in Anthracite over Warm Charcoal leather and is powered by a supercharged 4.0-liter V8 paired with a five-speed automatic transmission. Equipment includes a power-retractable black soft top, 20" BBS Montreal alloy wheels, heated power-adjustable Recaro front seats, navigation, cruise control, a remote CD changer, a cassette stereo, an Alpine sound system, and automatic climate control. Previously offered on BaT in January 2026 , this special-edition XKR convertible is now offered again at no reserve with the owner's manual, a car cover, a soft top boot, a clean Carfax report, and a Rhode Island title in the seller's name.
